narration: December 31st is seven weeks away — and there's $2,800 sitting on the table most people just walk away from. Four legal moves, all expiring midnight New Year's Eve.
visual: Dark background. Calendar showing November flipping to December with animated pages. Bold '7 WEEKS' counter spring-zooms in. Stack of cash SVG fades in underneath. Subtitle: 'THESE DOORS CLOSE DEC 31ST'

narration: Number one: spend your FSA before it burns. The average worker leaves $1,250 in their flexible spending account — and on January 1st, it's legally gone. It's your money. Use it.
visual: Light background. FSA credit card SVG with orange flame animation rising from it. Animated counter counts up to $1,250. Calendar date 'JAN 1' with an X through it. Medicine bottle and glasses SVGs at bottom.

narration: Number two: top off your HSA. It's the only account with a triple tax benefit — money goes in pre-tax, grows tax-free, and comes out tax-free. The 2026 limit is $4,150 if you haven't hit it.
visual: Dark background. Three shield icons spring in one by one labeled 'PRE-TAX IN', 'TAX-FREE GROWTH', 'TAX-FREE OUT'. Piggy bank SVG below with animated fill. '$4,150 LIMIT' text in green.

narration: Number three: harvest your losers. Any stocks sitting in the red in a taxable account — sell before December 31st to offset gains and cut your tax bill by up to $1,500.
visual: Light background. SVG line chart with descending red line. Animated scissors SVG slides across cutting the chart. '$1,500 TAX SAVINGS' counter animates in green. Arrow reverses to point upward.

narration: Number four: bunch your charitable donations. Give three years of donations in one year — you blow past the standard deduction, you itemize, and you save up to $400 in real taxes.
visual: Dark background. Bar chart showing three tiny $200 bars labeled 'YEAR 1/2/3' vs one large $600 bar labeled 'BUNCHED'. Heart/charity person SVG springs in. '$400 SAVED' text in green.

narration: Four moves, seven weeks, $2,800 back in your pocket. Do it this weekend — January 1st hits and every one of these doors closes for good for 2026.
visual: Dark background. Four checklist items spring in one by one: FSA, HSA, Tax Loss, Donations — each with an animated checkmark. '$2,800 TOTAL' springs in large and green. Bold CTA: 'DO IT THIS WEEKEND'
